intent: Reuse the existing source-preservation and Grounded Evidence owners to preserve and ground two later-vintage primary-source observations for the storage-semiconductor campaign: Samsung Q3 2023 demand/inventory recovery evidence and SK hynix Q2 2023 additional NAND production-reduction evidence. This admission stops at content-verified source capture plus CAP-0002 grounding; it does not yet evaluate Outcomes or create new Reality/Judgment semantics.
rationale: CAP-0001 already owns truthful content-verified source representations and CAP-0002 already owns claim-scoped grounding from those preserved representations. The later Samsung and SK hynix vintages are new source material for an existing campaign, not a new semantic capability. Outcome comparability remains a separate later admission after these fragments exist, so the current write cannot silently jump from discovery into Outcome evaluation.
